limits: One reused historical season, one own and one source-only neutral common opening per method; no independent season replications or inferential winner claim
Named architecture adaptations, shared scoring/availability layer and common bounded planner, not native competitors or the deployed artifact
Fixed wall-time solver and heuristic chip search can change paths between runs; selected bounds apply only to restricted pool/fixed schedule/proxy objective, not global chips or season confidence
Archive capture/publication claims, mutable historical statistics, older reconstructed training clocks and sparse news retained; missing news unknown; current-only official-zero policy experimental
OfficialEP has complete observed coverage but unreported publisher training lineage; H1 only, no future extension
Initial failed component-own arm retained; uniform source-only fallback repair reruns every arm without forecaster refit or parameter selection
Commonforecast externalplanner/native-system comparisons and endtoend policy qualification remain separate work
